RR3-B01.title: NONFINITE_SENTINELS_BREAK_STRICT_JSON_PACKAGING_OF_VALID_NEGATIVE_OR_PARTIAL_OUTCOMES
RR3-B01.finding: The frozen target uses math.inf and -math.inf as ordinary diagnostic sentinels for missing mesh-pair convergence, absent independent-backend distance, nonpositive cap geometry, and potentially singular condition estimates. The immutable result writer serializes with allow_nan=false. Consequently preregistered outcomes such as NO_CANDIDATE_FOUND_UNDER_PREREGISTERED_PROTOCOL, a rejected N=96 root, a partial seed history, or a singular diagnostic path can reach packaging with nonfinite values and fail JSON serialization instead of producing the required schema-complete negative result.
RR3-B01.required_closure: Replace every nonfinite sentinel crossing the immutable artifact boundary with one deterministic JSON-safe representation such as null plus an explicit status/reason field, or a finite tagged diagnostic object. Add recursive finite-value validation/sanitization before any immutable write and deterministic no-solve regression fixtures for no-candidate, partial, rejected-root and singular-diagnostic outcomes. Do not change numerical thresholds or reinterpret missing information as a finite measurement.

RR3-B02.title: TOTAL_DEADLINE_CAN_RACE_ATOMIC_RESULT_COMMIT_AND_PRODUCE_CONTRADICTORY_GRANT_STATE
RR3-B02.finding: The parent ITIMER_REAL intentionally remains armed through os.replace(staging, result_dir), while SUCCEEDED is recorded only after leaving the timer context. A SIGALRM or other BaseException delivered immediately after a successful atomic rename can enter the exception branch with an immutable result directory already committed. That branch currently hardcodes result_package_committed=false and marks the grant FAILED without checking or validating result_dir, allowing contradictory durable states: committed immutable result plus failed ledger.
RR3-B02.required_closure: Make the failure path commit-aware and fail closed. After any exception spanning the commit boundary, detect whether result_dir exists, verify the committed manifest/result hashes if present, and record an explicit COMMITTED_INDETERMINATE or equivalent non-replayable state rather than false FAILED metadata. Prefer a transaction phase marker immediately before rename and a post-rename durable commit marker so recovery is deterministic. Preserve the 21600 s hard deadline and do not silently delete or overwrite a committed result.

RR3-W01.title: HIGH_PRECISION_AUDIT_IS_NUMERICAL_QA_NOT_CONTINUUM_OR_STABILITY_EVIDENCE
RR3-W01.note: The >=80-bit H2 path is accepted here as a conservative residual/constraint QA gate for otherwise-passing candidates. It does not establish continuum existence, uniqueness, Fredholmness, stability, ghost freedom or physical viability.
